definitions.explanation: To engage in recreational activities for enjoyment. Used for children's play, games, and leisure activities.

definitions.gloss: to hang out, to spend time together
definitions.explanation: Casual way to describe spending leisure time with friends. Very common among young people.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちは{公園|こうえん}で{遊|あそ}んでいます。
examples.english: The children are playing in the park.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}、{友達|ともだち}と{遊|あそ}びました。
examples.english: I hung out with friends on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {遊|あそ}びに{来|き}てください。
examples.notes: 遊びに行く/来る = to go/come to hang out

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No transitive pair. Pattern: Xで{遊|あそ}ぶ (play at X) or Xと{遊|あそ}ぶ (play with X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {遊|あそ}んでいる = 'is playing/hanging out.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{友達|ともだち}と{遊|あそ}ぶ (hang out with friends)
・{公園|こうえん}で{遊|あそ}ぶ (play in the park)
・{遊|あそ}びに{行|い}く (go to hang out/visit)
・{遊|あそ}びに{来|く}る (come to visit/hang out)

The {遊|あそ}びに pattern is extremely common for casual social visits.
